notes.title: Runtime Branch Release 556.3
notes.notes:
Re-release of 556.3 on Steam "Runtime" branch.  To access:
[olist]
[*] [url=https://gist.github.com/jschavey/11d8c357bbe5c97b7627b642cb4192eb]Back up your save file[/url]
[*] Right Click "ClickRaid" and select "Properties"
[*] Select the "Beta" tab
[*] Enter beta code "ibackedupmysave"
[*] Select the "runtime" branch from the drop down
[/olist]

This branch will host the new game updates until all further runtime issues have been identified and resolved.  More stable then "daily" branch, but still some risk so please do actually back up your save before switching branches.  Let us know what issues if any you find so we can integrated fixes asap and resume our normal updates asap.

notes.title: Update 1.1.46
notes.notes:
Sorry about not posting patch notes for yesterday, most was just trying to optimize code and find memory leaks causing FPS drops.

Anyhow this patch will hopefully cover all current issues.

-Adv damage calculation fix had a + instead of a * for the fire arrow mult.
-Ninja finally getting a buff(sorry needed to see how it compared to other classes wasnt trying to ignore anyone, as i said several time in chat he will be fixed). Consider this a test of a fix. 
-Ninja will now buff firearrow to increase its stacks by hit projectile count and also for each level it will decrease the delay between the firearrow DOT ticks.
-Serverhost fix based on all the information i gathered the FPS drop might be due to just the sheer amount of packets the host has to send and calculate per second. The realtime mouse cursor movement seems to be the largest factor so im decrease its sync by about half. Once again if this doesnt fix the issue ill revert back but it will make other cursors movement slightly choppy and in the future i could fix this by handling movement like pet movement.
-General performance tweaks - I started using the same calculation that speeds up class projectiles on the heros with some success at decrease the amount of hero projectiles on the screen. Also i have removed the Blue XP objects from the monsters and am now just directly calculating the xp.
-Fixed merchant Xp not saving... Oops...
-Fixed some surfaces last night that wernt being cleared when they needed to be.

notes.title: Update 1.1.05
notes.notes:
-Fixed Enchanter buff level bug
-Fixed a Sorc buff level bug
-Completely recoded the Charm system(I like it much better now, not spoiling all the changes just got check it out!)
-Changed the way max level is calculated. Have tried 3 different ways to do this the fairest bestest way possible. I think its perfect now... 

Long explanation:
Old system we simply added your levels up, added all the levels that came from other players and generated a % of your contribution vs the group and returned buffs from that %... yea ppl hated that...

Next we took your max level class and then compared each classes level to yours. If they were higher they were reduced... If they were lower you recieved the full bonus. If 2 of the same class existed the same rules apply and you would get those additional levels. Subclass worked the same way except it used your max level class/2

New system:
Works the same as the last except how the max level is calculated. The new system Takes all your levels and all of your current XP and adds it up into one pool containing all the Class XP you have ever earned.
